_comment: Cursor MCP configuration — canonical memory server only.
sanctioned shape of the memory entry on the Cursor surface. Cursor's live
config (~/.cursor/mcp.json) is a REAL per-machine file rendered from
(make memory-mcp-install); the entry below is never copied from this file.
It is written by the memory package's own configurator
(`l9-memory client cursor install`) with the absolute interpreter of the
runtime this checkout is bound to (ops/config/memory-binding.json), because
Cursor expands no ${VAR} references. ${L9_MEMORY_INTERPRETER} here is the
NO CREDENTIAL VALUES and no env block: the server resolves its own
credentials (memory ADR-016). The legacy direct-provider front door
(graphiti-memory over a provider URL) is retired (realignment stage C7)
and the renderer drops it from every rendered file. The retired capability

l9-graphite-memory._owner: l9-graphite-memory: managed_server_entry (client_config/cursor.py); installed by the package configurator, never rendered from this template.
